title_zh: 为排练中的咒骂道歉并约定改用暂停

scenario.label_zh: 为排练中的咒骂道歉并约定改用暂停
scenario.goal_zh: 听取排练冲突造成的感受，承认咒骂冒犯，并约定以后用暂停请求代替

context_zh: 虚构业余剧团场景：一位成员为排练争执中的言语向队友道歉。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: I'm sorry I shouted at you in rehearsal. There was a lot of tension in the room, but that wasn't your fault.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: It felt as if you wanted to hurt me out of spite because I'd questioned your idea.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: I was embarrassed and reacted badly. I shouldn't swear at you just because we disagree.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: And when you stare at me without saying anything afterwards, I don't know whether it's safe to speak.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: I understand. If I need a break, I'll say so instead of shouting or glaring.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: All right. Let's agree that either of us can ask for a pause, without being mocked for it.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Agreed. And I'm sorry for what I said, not just for making the rehearsal awkward.
